notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: title Symmetrical interaction of sex and expression in face classification tasks; Luis Aguado, Ana García-Gutierrez and Ignacio Serrano-Pedraza; 2009, 71(1), 9–25; doi:10.3758/APP.71.1.9. Primary research article text with methods, results, references and appendices. No PDF supplied. Canonical parse contains corrupted mathematical symbols and omits p inequality operators. Target ambiguous: by-participant expression-classification interaction F(1,15) 11.47, partial eta-squared .43, p token .05; by-participant sex-classification interaction F(1,15) 9.96, partial eta-squared .39, p token .05; by-item expression-classification interaction F(1,28) 38.37, partial eta-squared .57, p token .001; by-item sex-classification interaction F(1,28) 8.44, partial eta-squared .23, p token .05. All four match the broad outcome and p. 13 locator. No selection by order/numeric matching. All displayed p tokens lack relation symbols. Overall 32 participants were split in half between tasks, giving candidate assignment count 32 / 2 = 16 per task; 32 face stimuli are documented separately, but final analytic participant/item N cannot be assigned to an unresolved target. Correct-response RTs only; no outliers identified. No N inferred from df. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
